verdict.rationale: Revenue recognition is a fair question for a billing and invoicing product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no ASC 606 / IFRS 15 recognition, deferred revenue schedules, or recognition reports. The only nearby items are customer payment-pattern reports and an integration with Zoho Books, which are adjacent features or other products and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data
